document.title: 6G & Smart City IoT Framework — Academic Publication
document.description: Peer-Reviewed Research published under Springer Nature addressing the 6G-Enabled Smart Cities paradigm, focusing on bandwidth and AI integration in home automation frameworks.

body.raw:
## Publication

**Springer Nature Link** · Conference Proceedings, pp. 137–150

## Abstract

This peer-reviewed conference paper addresses the "6G-Enabled Smart Cities" paradigm, exploring how ultra-high-bandwidth 6G connectivity combined with AI-driven home automation can unlock the next generation of intelligent urban infrastructure.

## Key Contributions

- Published as a **peer-reviewed conference paper (pp. 137–150)**, demonstrating rigorous academic validation and expert review.
- Conducted in-depth analysis on the **evolution of IoT connectivity** from 4G/5G to 6G, contributing to cyber-physical systems research.
- Proposed an architectural framework integrating **embedded systems and AI inference** at the edge for real-time smart home control.

## Tools & Domains

Internet Computing · IoT · 6G Networking · Embedded Systems · AI · Smart Cities

document.title: Fashion Hub — E-Commerce UI/UX Concept
document.description: Blending bold aesthetics with functional design to create an immersive retail experience.

body.raw:
## Overview

Designed a full responsive e-commerce platform focused on conversion-driven design, intuitive user flows, and a striking visual identity for a fashion retail brand.

## Design Highlights

- Utilized a **vibrant color palette and bold typography** to create a visually striking, brand-forward interface.
- Designed a full **product discovery flow**: homepage → category → product detail → checkout, optimized for conversion.
- Ensured high functionality and intuitive user flows across multiple device formats (mobile, tablet, desktop).

## Tools & Stack

Figma · Prototyping · Responsive Design · Color Theory · Visual Hierarchy

Designed a high-fidelity mobile application UI/UX concept for a task management tool, prioritizing user interaction clarity and minimalist visual design.

## Design Highlights

- Successfully transitioned from **low-fidelity wireframes** to a comprehensive high-fidelity design system.
- Optimized visual hierarchy to enhance task persistence and interaction clarity across all key screens.
- Applied **color theory** and micro-interaction principles to create an engaging, distraction-free experience.

## Tools & Stack

document.title: Netflix Global Content Strategy & Growth Analytics
document.description: Mapping the evolution of a streaming giant through data engineering and visual storytelling.

body.raw:
## Overview

Developed a Python-based data cleaning pipeline and built a comprehensive Tableau dashboard to visualize Netflix's 2014–2019 "Content Explosion" era, mapping the platform's strategic shift from US-centric content to a global production powerhouse.

## Key Findings

- Identified that the library remains **70% movie-heavy** despite global audience shifts toward episodic content.
- Uncovered International Dramas as the **primary engine for non-US growth**, indicating a deliberate strategy of using cinema as a market-entry vehicle.
- Mapped regional production hubs and their contribution to Netflix's subscriber growth milestones.

## Tools & Stack

Python · Pandas · Tableau · Data Engineering · EDA

document.title: Oasis Hospital Solution — UI/UX Design
document.description: Designed a modular service grid, user-centric onboarding, and strategic CTA workflows for a healthcare platform.

body.raw:
## Overview

Designed an end-to-end UI/UX system for a multi-service hospital platform, covering patient onboarding, service discovery, and conversion-optimized call-to-action flows.

## Design Highlights

- Created a **custom card-based modular service grid** allowing easy future expansion for categories like Medical Tourism and Specialist Referrals.
- Integrated **social login onboarding** to lower friction barriers for new policyholders and partners.
- Strategically placed **"Know More" and "Login" CTAs** at key decision points to guide users toward conversion.
- Leveraged custom illustrations to visually differentiate user types (patients, partners, staff) across the platform.

## Tools & Stack

Figma · Component Design · Visual Hierarchy · Responsive Layouts · Illustration

document.title: Retail Sales & Customer Behavior Analytics
document.description: Decoding consumer trends to drive revenue growth through EDA and Python. I analyzed a retail transaction dataset to identify high-value customer segments and product performance.

body.raw:
## Overview

Analyzed a retail transaction dataset to decode purchasing patterns, identify high-value customer segments, and surface product performance insights using Python and Pandas.

## Key Findings

- Uncovered that **30–50 year-olds** drive the highest average spend per transaction.
- Identified top-performing product categories contributing to 60%+ of total revenue.
- Provided a clear segmentation target for marketing optimization to drive sustainable revenue growth.

## Tools & Stack

Python · Pandas · Seaborn · Matplotlib · Tableau · EDA

document.title: Dynamic Task Management Web App
document.description: A sleek, persistent To-Do application built with vanilla JavaScript and Local Storage, focusing on a zero-loss user experience.

body.raw:
## Overview

Built a fully functional To-Do application using vanilla JavaScript featuring real-time DOM manipulation and data persistence via the `localStorage` API — ensuring tasks are never lost across sessions.

## Technical Highlights

- Implemented the **localStorage API** for complete data persistence and state management without a backend.
- Engineered input validation and vanilla JavaScript **DOM manipulation** for seamless real-time task creation, editing, and deletion.
- Applied a modern glassmorphism UI with smooth transitions for a premium feel.

## Tools & Stack

JavaScript · HTML · CSS · Local Storage · DOM Manipulation

document.title: Vegetable Market App — UI/UX Design
document.description: A comprehensive UI/UX design featuring component-driven product cards, an immersive onboarding experience, and engaging micro-interactions for a fresh produce marketplace.

body.raw:
## Overview

Designed a full mobile app UI/UX experience for a fresh vegetable marketplace, optimizing for discoverability, conversion, and a delightful shopping experience.

## Design Highlights

- Created **reusable product cards** with strategic calls-to-action (Add to Cart, Quick View) to increase conversion rates.
- Designed a **5-tab bottom navigation bar** for instant access to Home, Search, Cart, Orders, and Profile.
- Planned **intuitive checkout banners and promotional sliders** to maximize average order value.
- Applied a fresh, vibrant color palette aligned with the brand's natural, farm-to-table identity.

## Tools & Stack

document.title: WiFiScan — Wireless Diagnostic Tool
document.description: Engineered a Python-based diagnostic utility featuring hardware interfacing and multi-module scanning to parse raw network data into human-readable reports.

body.raw:
## Overview

Engineered a modular, command-line Python diagnostic utility that interfaces directly with wireless hardware to capture, scan, and report on local network topology.

## Technical Highlights

- Built a **modular architecture** for packet capture, active host discovery, and port scanning using Scapy and the Socket library.
- Engineered backend communication with **PCIe adapters** to retrieve and parse GUID and physical MAC address data.
- Outputs clean, human-readable scan reports from raw network packet data.

## Tools & Stack

Python · Scapy · Socket Library · Network Protocols · PCIe Hardware Interfacing
